about.title: About Us
about.p1: CodeCasters is a software development team specialized in modern web applications. We prioritize clean code, maintainable architectures, and efficient solutions tailored to each problem.
about.p2: While our strength lies in web development, we also build desktop applications, mobile apps, and general-purpose tools when the project requires it.
